note: jQuery MiniColors provides one field widget 'jquery_minicolors_widget' (extends core StringTextfieldWidget) for 'string' (Text plain) fields; the color is stored as a plain string. Per-field state is the entity_form_display component: type=jquery_minicolors_widget plus widget settings (control, format hex/rgb, swatches, position, theme, ...) under field.widget.settings.jquery_minicolors_widget. It needs the external jQuery MiniColors JS library at /libraries/jquery-minicolors (front-end only; irrelevant to config verification). No config object, no permissions, no Drush, no plugin type. Medium cases seed a real string field using the widget (and a known format setting); hard cases require switching a string field's widget to jquery_minicolors_widget, verified against the live form display.

evals.prompt: Which Drupal field type can the jQuery MiniColors color-picker widget be used on, and what is the widget's plugin id?
evals.expected_output: The widget id is jquery_minicolors_widget; it works on 'string' (Text plain) fields (it extends core's StringTextfieldWidget) and stores the color as a plain string.

evals.prompt: The jQuery MiniColors picker isn't showing up on my color field. What external library does the module need and where must it be installed?
evals.expected_output: It needs the jQuery MiniColors JS library (v2.2.4) installed at /libraries/jquery-minicolors/, with jquery.minicolors.min.js and jquery.minicolors.css present. hook_requirements() reports it on /admin/reports/status if missing.

evals.prompt: Name some of the settings you can configure on the jQuery MiniColors field widget (for example, to choose the color notation or show preset colors).
evals.expected_output: Settings include control (hue/brightness/saturation/wheel), format (hex/rgb), opacity, swatches (preset colors), position, theme (default/bootstrap), inline, letter_case, animation/show/hide speeds, change_delay, keywords, plus core size/placeholder.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has one field whose edit widget is the jQuery MiniColors color picker. Inspect the live default form display for Article and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: field_jqmc_known — in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default its component has type: jquery_minicolors_widget.

evals.prompt: The Article field 'field_jqmc_fmt' uses the jQuery MiniColors widget on this site. Inspect the live form-display configuration and state which color format (notation) that widget is configured to use.
evals.expected_output: rgb — the field_jqmc_fmt component's jquery_minicolors_widget settings have format: rgb.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a Text (plain) field field_jqmc_task currently using the default text field widget. Change the default form display so field_jqmc_task uses the jQuery MiniColors color-picker widget, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default set the field_jqmc_task component type to 'jquery_minicolors_widget' (via Manage form display, or setComponent(['type'=>'jquery_minicolors_widget'])).

evals.prompt: My articles have a plain text box called field_jqmc_task2 where I type a color code. I'd like editors to pick the color with a visual color picker instead of typing it. Please make that happen on the live site (I have the jQuery MiniColors module).
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default set the field_jqmc_task2 component type to 'jquery_minicolors_widget'.
